name: section-frontmatter
body: A plain ``` fence (no language tag) immediately after a section heading — at any nesting depth — is that section's YAML frontmatter; this fence form is used only for sections (slide frontmatter uses `---` … `---` at the top of the file). It must include `template:` when the section accepts more than one section template; may be omitted when exactly one is accepted. A language tag on it = error; a fence anywhere else = error. The rest of the section is its body.
